premise: Every time Dog runs into the waves he comes back and shakes all over Lola, so she turns the umbrella into a shield, and Dog thanks her with a big wet lick anyway.
inspiration: The three-tries comic pattern (the fool who repeats the trick), ending with the trick outfoxed and forgiven.
lesson: You can't stay cross with a happy dog.

en-US.title: Dog Shakes
en-US.text: {girl:enter} Lola was sitting under {umbrella:enter} the umbrella, {girl:go under umbrella} nice and dry. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Dog was not dry. {dog:go to shore} He ran down to the water, {sfx:splash} splash! {dog:go to girl} And back he came, {dog:live} and SHOOK. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] "Dog! I'm all wet!" [playfully] Off he went again. {dog:go to shore} Splash… {dog:go to girl} and back, {dog:live} SHAKE! {girl:shake} {girl:says} [laughs] "Not AGAIN!" [short pause] So Lola had a plan. When Dog came back the third time, {umbrella:live} she spun the umbrella round to face him, like a big red-and-white shield. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} Shake, shake, shake! Every drop landed on the umbrella. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [proudly] "Ha! Dry!" {dog:face happy} Dog wagged his tail, {dog:go to girl} trotted round the umbrella… and gave her a big, wet lick on the nose. {girl:says} [giggles] "Oh, DOG!" {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: Perro se sacude
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} Lola estaba sentada debajo de {umbrella:enter} la sombrilla, {girl:go under umbrella} sequita. {girl:face happy} {dog:enter} Perro no estaba seco. {dog:go to shore} Bajó corriendo hasta el agua, {sfx:splash} ¡chof! {dog:go to girl} Y volvió, {dog:live} y se SACUDIÓ. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Perro! ¡Me has mojado!» [playfully] Allá fue otra vez. {dog:go to shore} Chof… {dog:go to girl} y de vuelta, {dog:live} ¡SACUDIDA! {girl:shake} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡OTRA vez no!» [short pause] Así que Lola tuvo una idea. Cuando Perro volvió por tercera vez, {umbrella:live} giró la sombrilla hacia él, como un gran escudo rojo y blanco. {dog:shake} {umbrella:spray} ¡Sacude, sacude, sacude! Todas las gotas cayeron en la sombrilla. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [proudly] «¡Ja! ¡Seca!» {dog:face happy} Perro movió la cola, {dog:go to girl} rodeó la sombrilla… y le dio un gran lametón mojado en la nariz. {girl:says} [giggles] «¡Ay, PERRO!» {dog:hearts}
